We are meeting 11am-1pm today (Wed. Feb 12th), 11am-1pm, and 5pm-7pm Saturday (Feb 15th) EST here:

Let me know if you are interested, and I will add you to our group chat. We already have some very talented people interested in this project, and if you're inclined to social media analysis or even just want to work on a collaborative project, it is an excellent opportunity to meet highly intelligent agentic individuals that might transpire into further collaboration!

Projects are the things we manage to develop people and relationships - not the other way around. It is through working on these things that we come to know people, who they are and how we can rely on each other. These things are the doorways to deeper relationships, collaboration and community.
